newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris bourse star Carrefour hits new high.
newsitem.headline: Paris bourse star Carrefour hits new high.

text.p: Shares in Carrefour hit a fresh high on Thursday, buoyed by talk that the retail group was on a U.S. roadshow -- a rumour denied by the company.
It said the rumour may have arisen out of its participation last week at a conference in Boston of food and retail groups.
The share was up 3.59 percent at 4,179 francs at 1400 GMT after easing from a historic high of 4,210 francs. The blue chip CAC-40 index was up 2.07 percent at the same time.
The stock, which has gone from peak to peak in the past year, is viewed as a safe investment under the new Socialist-led government whose policies are seen favouring consumption.
"Carrefour is a safe stock. It's a stock that's in every major European investor's portfolio. The Germans and Swiss are big buyers today," a trader said.
"The Americans are reinforcing their positions in this share, which is one of the best," said another trader.
